steps.prompt: Before the check: which counting tool do you reach for fastest now, and which one do you still have to stop and think about?

cards.title: Arranging and choosing: quick review
cards.body: Steps in a row multiply; "or" adds. Restrictions first (no leading $0$). In order: $n!$ and $\frac{n!}{(n - k)!}$; divide by the shuffles of repeated items; round table $(n - 1)!$. No order: $\binom{n}{k}$; grid paths $\binom{a + b}{a}$; handshakes $\binom{n}{2}$.

cards.title: Cases and opposites: quick review
cards.body: Casework: split into cases that don't overlap and cover everything, then add. Complementary counting: "at least one" $=$ total $-$ none; "not together" $=$ total $-$ together.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
